# New insights & hypotheses --- NOT EVIDENCE {#sec-hypotheses}

::: callout-warning
## Hard wall
Everything in this section is generated inference, **not** a finding of the literature. It is
unsupported by the studies reviewed above. Do not cite it as evidence, do not quote it as a
conclusion, and do not carry any sentence from it into the preceding sections.
:::

<!-- Every item is phrased conditionally and carries a testable prediction. Citations here point
     to what PROMPTED the idea; they do not make the idea evidenced. Verifier check
     C-HYPOTHESIS-WALL fails the run if a hypothesis is phrased as an established finding. -->
